correctness.rationale: The factorization (x+y)(1+xy)/(xy) and CRT give exactly 2g-1 zero spectral blocks each of k*l dimension. The central zero block has exact index max(1,k/2,l/2), while each noncentral zero block (only when g>1) has exact index max(k,l) via local derivative and a truncated coordinate change. Thus all recurrent and sharp-time formulas follow; the peak transient percentage follows from penultimate-power rank. Independently coded direct graph updates verified ranks for 144 ordered size pairs and every initial state on 4 small tori (74,240 configurations). The program's finite range is not the proof of the infinite statement.

value.rationale: An exact global-state attractor census and sharp transient time are basic natural invariants of the nearest-neighbour parity automaton on rectangular tori. The formulas uncover two different interacting arithmetic parameters (odd-part gcd controls recurrent codimension; two-adic circumferences control timing) and a sharp peak-depth probability, with a nontrivial all-power-of-two extinction regime. Neither a gratuitous slice nor merely a generic computational rank statement.
